methods.label: Find the edge from the surface area
methods.explanation:
A cube of volume \(1\) has edge length \(1\), so its six square faces have total area \(6\).

Let \(s>0\) be the edge length of the new cube. Its surface area is twice \(6\), so
\[
6s^2=12,\qquad s^2=2.
\]
An edge length is positive, so \(s=\sqrt2\). Its volume is therefore
\[
s^3=s^2\cdot s=2\sqrt2.
\]
The answer is \(2\sqrt2\), choice C.
